name: Ak'Zeloth
label: Quest
description: Neeru Fireblade sends you from Orgrimmar into the Barrens after signs of demonic corruption emerge. His contact waits near the border.

clips.title: The story
paras: Neeru Fireblade sends you from Orgrimmar into the Barrens after signs of demonic corruption emerge. His contact waits near the border.

Neeru Fireblade says the Burning Blade still threatens the Horde with demonic corruption. After you bring him a Burning Blade insignia collar from Durotar, he sends you into the Barrens. A cult gathers around the Demon Seed, an artifact of vile power, and Neeru wants you to find his contact near the border.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Since the last great war when the Burning Legion was defeated, I have searched for sources of demonic corruption in orc society. The collar you brought me confirms my fears.
It belongs to the Burning Blade, a cult that rallies around an item of demonic power. It is called the Demon Seed, and it resides in the Barrens atop Dreadmist Peak. It must be destroyed!
Go to Far Watch Post, on the border of the Barrens to the west, and speak with my assistant, Ak'Zeloth. He will direct you further.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Neeru wants the Demon Seed destroyed, does he? Strange...
Very well. If he wishes the seed gone, then I will tell you how to remove it.
